critique: The delivered matched minimax theorem is confined to the known-design subfamily d=1, beta=1, and alpha>=1; the rate for the note's broader d-dimensional Hölder class, including possible nuisance–contamination interactions, remains open in oeq:full-frontier. Within that stated subfamily, the upper and lower bounds concern the same contaminated experiment and establish the claimed clean elbow, contamination modulus, and simultaneous attainment, so the framing contains no stale claim of a solved general frontier. The paper's significance is limited by the highly structured uniform one-dimensional design and by the absence of inference results or supporting numerical evidence showing the finite-sample usefulness of the proposed trimming scale. These restrictions keep the package below the strongest matched-frontier papers despite clearing the field threshold.
